{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == 999999.99
qa_orders = df[qa_mask]

# Print key values
print(f'QA order count: {len(qa_orders)}')
print(f'QA order revenue value: {999999.99}')
print(f'QA order status: {qa_orders["status"].unique()}')

# Exclude QA orders
non_qa_df = df[~qa_mask]

# Count completed and refunded orders in non-QA data
completed_count = (non_qa_df['status'] == 'completed').sum()
refunded_count = (non_qa_df['status'] == 'refunded').sum()

print(f'Completed orders (excluding QA): {completed_count}')
print(f'Refunded orders (excluding QA): {refunded_count}')
print(f'Total non-QA rows: {len(non_qa_df)}')

# Verify consistency
assert completed_count + refunded_count == len(non_qa_df), 'Sum of completed and refunded does not match non-QA total'

completed_count"}
